English:
Wohnly is the all-in-one household management app that helps you and your family stay organized together. Whether you live with a partner, roommates, or family, Wohnly keeps everyone on the same page.

Manage shared to-do lists, shopping lists, chores, expenses, meal plans, and a household calendar — all in one place. Every member of your household can contribute, check off tasks, and stay up to date in real time.

Key highlights:

Shared to-do lists and personal tasks
Collaborative shopping lists
Chore management with fair share analytics
Expense tracking and splitting
Meal planning with shopping list integration
Household calendar for events and schedules
Invite members with a simple code
End-to-end encryption for your household data
Beautiful dark and light themes
Available in 42 languages
Works across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and web
Wohnly is free to use. Sign in with Google or Apple, create your household, and invite your family or roommates to get started.
